name: Nivaka Fashions Ltd.
summary: Established in 1983, Nivaka Fashions Ltd. is an Indian company based in Bhiwandi, primarily involved in the trade of textiles and luggage. Its extensive product offerings include leather goods, travel accessories, and a variety of ready-to-wear clothing, such as hosiery. Additionally, the firm supplies household linens, various articles of apparel, floor coverings, and tapestries.
